provenance.command: pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command $now = Get-Date Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | ForEach-Object {   [ordered]@{ pid = $_.ProcessId; ppid = $_.ParentProcessId;     processGroup = [ordered]@{ status = 'unsupported'; nearestConcept = 'process tree rooted at a PID' };     state = if ($null -eq $_.ExecutionState) { 'not_reported' } else { [string]$_.ExecutionState };     elapsedSeconds = if ($null -eq $_.CreationDate) { $null } else { [math]::Round(($now - $_.CreationDate).TotalSeconds, 3) };     executableName = $_.Name } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
